new_or_changed_insights: OSS-0028 is HOLDOUT and remains score-only: tracing beyond a thin API entrypoint found the exact fail-closed secret validator and its bootstrap call, validating the rule that delegation must be followed before absence is inferred.

OSS-0029 is HOLDOUT and remains score-only: a cleartext manifest permission did not itself prove a live HTTP path; the requested discriminator then found both an all-interface HTTP connector and a 2026 user report successfully using http://:8080. The problem therefore sharpened from proxy suspicion to an explicit TLS-claim versus supported-HTTP contract boundary.

OSS-0030 strengthens inferred_sibling_contract_laundering and encodability restraint: an old TODO plus a sibling control did not authorize a build. The owner later documented that the legacy codebase was being retired/re-written, strongly supporting the defer decision.

saturation.decision_modes: No new routing mode; DISCRIMINATE_FIRST and OWNER_DEFER receive additional independent cases.
saturation.failure_families: No genuinely new family. The taxonomy is stabilizing, while existing family boundaries continue to gain cross-domain evidence.
saturation.authority_boundaries: No new Neta authority error. SparkleShare adds strong owner-roadmap adjudication; Plain App demonstrates that a REPO discriminator can turn a static permission into a materially different contract question.
saturation.baseline_deltas: Two additional fully surviving deltas were added. Across BATCH-009 and BATCH-010, four deltas survived adjudication, so the earlier marginal-advantage saturation signal is not sustained.
